# IBRA

Hebrew spelling and pronunciation: איברה (ee-BRA).

> The problem IBRA solves: people train at home, sometimes for years, and don't see real change in their body. IBRA builds a plan for the equipment the user already owns, runs it set by set, measures the body (shoulders, waist, photos, posture) and progresses the plan every week. Free for every man. IBRA Pro connects the user's own AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini), which also sees the progress photos and fine-tunes the plan weekly. Workouts of about 30–40 minutes.
>
> IBRA is an iOS app (Hebrew-first): a daily player for sets, rest and meals, body measurements and photos, and a weekly close that progresses the plan (and, in Pro, sends what really happened to the chat for adjustments). No account, no server; data stays on the phone and in the user's iCloud. One free sample day without signing up. Pricing: the core app is free with no AI required (IBRA builds the first plan from your equipment and goal, runs it and progresses it at each weekly close). IBRA Pro connects your own AI chat as a coach, plus photo analysis, body fat, posture, charts and the Apple Watch app: ₪249.90/year or ₪44.90/month; the first close with the coach is free. The AI chat is billed separately by its provider. Separately from price, the user gives "their word" (a goal, sessions per week, a weekly sign-off); two missed closes lead to renewing the word, with no fee and no data loss. Cancelling never locks data.
